pages.title: ORSA Transponder
pages.text: ORSA's last-resort beacon. It broadcasts to surviving relay satellites.

pages.title: Schematic
pages.text: Building one needs the $(bold)ORSA Transponder Schematic$(), a classified document in ORSA wreckage. Archive it first.$(br2)$(flavor)"We hid the escape plan in a random structure. Also the cafeteria key." ORSA Security$()
4 Refined Acheronite, 2 Diamond Blocks, a Thermal Core, a Frozen Heart and an Atmosphere Shard.$(br2)$(flavor)A phone call to space. Long distance rates apply.$()

pages.title: Activation
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Depth:$() below Y=0$(li)$(bold)Power:$() Geothermal Core within 12 blocks$(li)$(bold)Sky:$() an open shaft straight up, no solid blocks$(li)$(bold)Schematic:$() archived$(br2)Right-click to start.

pages.name: Broadcast Site
pages.text: Below Y=0, Core beside it, shaft open all the way to the sky.

pages.title: Broadcast
pages.text: It takes about $(bold)100 minutes$(). A beam rises through the shaft; pause and resume from the interface.$(br2)If a condition fails it pauses with a warning, and resumes once fixed.
The signal clears snow from the shaft.$(br2)$(flavor)ORSA's most practical feature, designed by accident.$()
